name: AI Tools Explorer

sources.title: Submit AI Tool page (via search index; direct fetch 403-blocked) — two paid tiers: AI Visa $49 one-time, AI Passport $129 one-time, published within 24h
FAQ — 'Make sure your AI tool is fully operational, including its website. NSFW tools are not accepted.'
Third-party listing — reports paid-only submission, dofollow link

requirements: AI tool must be fully operational with a functional website and clearly defined pricing
SFW only — NSFW tools not accepted
Generic names rejected (e.g. 'Free AI image generator', 'Best AI tool')
No free tier: AI Visa $49 one-time (editorial page, 1 direct link) or AI Passport $129 one-time (2 direct links, video embed, filter-page placement, homepage promotion, free profile updates)
preparation: Tool name (distinctive, not generic), URL, pricing model
Feature list, specific use cases, integrations, AI models used, compliance certifications — the editorial team writes your profile from this

Decide Visa vs Passport: Passport adds a second link, video embed, placement across matching filter pages (integrations/models/platforms/audience), and free future profile updates (Visa updates cost ~$25)
workflow: Open aitoolsexplorer.com/submit-ai-tool/ and fill the form (features, use cases, integrations, differentiators)
Choose AI Visa ($49) or AI Passport ($129) and pay
Editorial team builds the 'AI Passport/Visa' profile page; published within 24 hours
Verify the dedicated profile page is live and placed on relevant category/filter pages
watchFor: Site 403-blocks automated fetches — form must be driven in a real browser
This is a paid-only destination; do not assume a free listing exists
AI Visa profile updates cost extra later; Passport includes them
Affiliate program pays 35% — expect affiliate-driven 'reviews' of the directory elsewhere
countsAsLive: A dedicated editorial profile page for the tool resolves on aitoolsexplorer.com with direct link button(s) to the product site
unknowns: Refund/rejection policy if a paid submission fails review
Direct confirmation that Visa/Passport links are dofollow (third-party reports yes)
